# Nexyyra Events

> Luxury event management company headquartered in Telhara, Maharashtra, India — weddings, corporate events, destination celebrations, and celebrity experiences across Pune and all of India since 2012. Founded by Yash Bajaj in Amravati in 2012; Aaditya Padiya and Amey Korde joined as co-founders in 2026.

Legal name: Nexyyra Events and Promotions Private Limited
CIN: U70200ME2026PTC476014
Website: https://www.nexyyra.com
Email: Info.Events@nexyyra.com
Founders: Yash Bajaj (Founder & Managing Director, 2012), Aaditya Padiya (Co-Founder & CTO, 2026), Amey Korde (Co-Founder & CMO, 2026)
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/nexyyra/

## About

Nexyyra Events is a premium event planning and production company serving clients across India. We specialize in end-to-end luxury experiences — from intimate weddings to large-scale corporate galas and destination celebrations.

## Services

- Luxury Wedding Planning
- Destination Weddings
- Corporate Events & Brand Activations
- Celebrity & VIP Event Management
- Concert & Exhibition Management
- Fashion Shows & Cultural Events
- Venue Curation & Event Production
